claim: Generated interventions are bounded by a budget over four dimensions: file count, line count, token count, and change count. This study sweeps each dimension across budget levels (0/20/40/60/80/100% of the cost of covering every risk) and measures how many real ranked risks a highest-score-first generator can cover. It proves coverage is monotonic non-decreasing in budget, that zero budget covers nothing and full budget covers everything, and that each dimension has a diminishing-returns knee so maintainers can choose a budget with evidence.
